messages:
sam: CISO at prospect asked for a concise breakdown of Redwood's incident timelines and who takes regulatory/third-party notifications during a POC. Need something they can paste into their vendor review. Keep it short.

tasha: Copyable bullets coming. First Q: is this a Hosted POC (we run infra) or a Private/VPC POC (they run infra)? Handling differs.

sam: Hosted, but they want to understand the Private option too.

tasha: Got it. Drafted snippet: 
- Hosted (Redwood-managed): If Redwood confirms an incident affecting customer data, we notify the customer's designated security contact within 24 hours of confirmation and provide a 72-hour initial incident summary. Continuous updates provided until containment.
- Private / VPC / On-prem: Customer controls compute and keys. Redwood assists per the SOW/MSA; notification duties to regulators/customers remain with the Customer unless the agreement assigns joint notification.
- Forensics & evidence: For hosted services we can provide request logs, system telemetry, and hashed evidence exports. Chain-of-custody exports and deeper forensic work are available via the enterprise forensics retainer or as a billable engagement.
- Keys & backups: If customer provides KMS or BYO keys, Redwood cannot decrypt data without an explicit, documented key-sharing agreement. Backups managed by Redwood in Hosted deployments are described in the SOW addendum.
- Regulatory filings: Redwood will not submit regulatory notifications on customer's behalf without written instruction; we will prepare redacted facts and cooperate with counsel.
- Post-incident deliverables: initial triage summary (72h), full incident report and remediation plan (target 30 days), and a final postmortem (target 60 days) depending on scope.

nate: Add an escalation matrix snippet we can paste into SOWs and POCs.

lexi: Here's a short escalation matrix you can paste: 
Tier 1 (Operational) - On-call engineer, ack within 1 hour.
Tier 2 (Incident Lead) - Eng lead + security SME, engaged within 2 hours for Sev1.
Tier 3 (Executive) - CISO/Legal notified within 6 hours for confirmed breaches; press/PR coordination only with Customer sign-off.

legal-bot: Suggested legal wording (short):
```
Incident Response and Notification:
- Redwood will notify Customer's designated security contact within 24 hours after confirming unauthorized access to Customer Data for Hosted services.
- For Private deployments, Redwood will assist in investigations per the Agreement; Customer retains responsibility for external notifications unless otherwise agreed.
- Redwood will provide an initial factual summary within 72 hours and a collaborative remediation plan within 30 days. Any regulator or public statements require Customer approval unless legally compelled.
```

sam: Good. Two extras: 1) log retention numbers (they asked how long we keep artifacts), 2) cost/retainer note for deep forensics.

tasha: Retention defaults we usually quote for POCs: request-level traces (30 days), KV/cache trace window (configurable, default 7 days), infra/metric logs (90 days). For Dedicated/Hosted enterprise customers we offer 180+ days as an add-on. For Private deployments, logs reside in customer accounts unless explicit collection is enabled.

lexi: For forensic work we recommend: include an optional forensics retainer in the SOW (flat monthly fee for on-call access + discounted engagement rate), otherwise we perform investigations on a time-and-materials basis. Good to flag cost to avoid surprises.

nate: Also call out: we won't independently notify regulators or customers. We escalate internally and prepare downloads; customer legal decides external communications. Put that in bold in email pls.

tasha: Short email-ready paragraph you can paste:
"For Hosted POCs Redwood operates the service and will notify your designated security contact within 24 hours of confirming unauthorized access to customer data and provide a 72-hour initial summary plus a joint remediation plan. For Private/VPC or on-prem deployments where you control infrastructure and keys, notification responsibility remains with you while Redwood provides investigative assistance per the SOW. We recommend a brief SOW addendum listing named security/legal contacts, an escalation matrix, log/export rights, KMS ownership, and an optional forensics retainer to speed investigations and reduce delays during incident response."

sam: Perfect. Can you also include a short line about public statements/press?

lexi: Sure: "Public statements and regulator filings will only be made with Customer approval, except where Redwood is legally compelled to act; Redwood will notify Customer counsel immediately if a legal requirement to disclose arises."

sam: Thanks all. Will send to CISO and add the forensics retainer option into the POC quote. :white_check_mark:
